test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. One of them may contain an error. Select the option that contains the error. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.**

The soldier met a fearless death fighting on behalf at his country.

options.text: fighting on behalf at his country

solution:
The correct answer is: "**fighting on behalf at his country**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in this sentence lies in the use of the preposition "**at**" after "**on behalf**."
 
• The correct preposition to use in this context is "**of**." 
 
• The phrase "**on behalf of**" is used to indicate representing or in the interest of someone or something.
 
• It is a fixed expression and the preposition "**of**" is the correct choice to follow it.
 
• **Corrected Sentence**: "*The soldier met a fearless death fighting on behalf of his country.*"
 
• The corrected sentence uses "**on behalf of his country**," which is the appropriate and idiomatic way to express that the soldier was fighting for the interests or in the name of his country.

Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer.
